---
name: Feature request or chore
about: A new capability, an improvement, or maintenance work
title: "feat: "
labels: needs-triage
---

## Summary

<!-- The affected component and the outcome you want, in one or two sentences. -->

## Problem and current workflow

<!-- What the user or maintainer does today and where it hurts. Facts you measured; mark anything unknown as unknown. -->

## Desired behavior

<!-- What should be observable once this is done. Describe behavior, not an unproven implementation. -->

## Concrete example

<!-- An exact command, input and the output you expect. For tooling or chores, the exact check that should pass. -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- Other approaches and why they were not chosen. Write "None considered" if so. -->

## Scope

<!-- What to build or change. -->

## Evidence

<!-- Logs, measurements or screenshots of the existing friction. Label proposed mockups as proposals. State what you could not capture. -->

## Acceptance criteria

<!-- Unchecked, externally observable pass/fail conditions, each checkable by running a command or inspecting a file or page. -->

- [ ]

## Out of scope and dependencies

<!-- Related work that belongs in another issue. Add "Blocked by #N" if this depends on one. -->
